Maria G: Heads up — p99 latency on dedicated-pool-us-west-2 jumped ~3.2x at 15:03 UTC. p95 is fine. Seeing correlation with a small number of requests that have very long prompts + tool calls.
Kevin L: Can you paste the short window logs + any profiling?
Maria G: putting a short capture. most requests are normal but these outliers sit in gen stage then spin on tool-call handler.
Maria G: infra-bot reported this alert: 
infra-bot: ALERT p99_slo_breach service=redwood-inference pool=dedicated-pool-us-west-2 p99=1.9s target=350ms
Oliver S: Weird, we rolled the adaptive microbatching tuner at 14:58 — threshold increased from 8->16 for throughput optimization. Could be a batching/latency tradeoff edge.
Priya N: Traffic didn't change — small spike in long-prompt usage (user agent=enterprise-ingest) around the same time.
Kevin L: Maria, can you attach a sample flame/prof? even a sampled hotspot log helps.
Maria G: here's a sampled hotspot (2000 samples) for one outlier request:

```
PID 1243 - sampled hotspots (2000 samples)
kernel_select             48%  # decision + dispatch
kv_lookup                 28%  # frequent misses on long-prefix
serialize                 10%
epoll_wait                 6%
toolcall_handler          4%   # waiting on external tool/loop
other                      4%
```

Maria G: Notes: kv_lookup time is dominated by prefix mismatch + rehydrate path (disk->GPU memcpy). Toolcall_handler shows brief waits but we see reentrancy into gen after tool returns.
Oliver S: Two hypotheses: (A) adaptive microbatch bumped batch size so long-prompt requests get queued behind more in-flight work, increasing p99 when KV misses rewarm; (B) kernel_selector chose a throughput-optimized kernel variant that increases cold-KV penalty for long contexts.
Kevin L: Agree. We should check kernel selection decisions for those requests — tag shows kernel_variant=v2-throughput in traces?
Maria G: yes, trace snippet shows kernel_variant=v2-throughput and batch_size=12 for the outlier.
Priya N: Ops: I can throttle rollout and force batch cap 8 on the pool if we want quick mitigation.
Kevin L: Do it. Also add a short experiment: pin kernel_variant to v1-lowlatency for 1000 requests and measure p99.
Maria G: Quick mitigation executed: set pool.config.max_microbatch=8 at 15:12 UTC. infra-bot: 
deploy-bot: config-update applied pool=dedicated-pool-us-west-2 max_microbatch=8 by Priya N
Maria G: After cap, p99 dropped back to ~320ms within ~2m. no customer impact reported.
Oliver S: For root cause repro we need to synthesize: long prompt + tool-call that triggers KV miss + variant=v2-throughput + batch>=10. I'll write a small harness to replay with variable batch sizes and kernel flags.
Kevin L: Also add a microbench for KV rehydrate path: measure memcpy times for 2K, 8K, 32K prefix sizes under v1/v2 kernels. If v2 has worse memcpy overlap, that explains the jump.
Priya N: Logging improvement request: include kernel_variant and microbatch_size in the request span for all production traces — makes postmortems faster.
Maria G: Filing quick infra TODOs:
- Priya: keep max_microbatch=8 on pool until next canary (done).
- Oliver: harness + memcpy microbench (ETA today EOD).
- Kevin: experiment pin kernel_variant=v1-lowlatency for 1k reqs + compare p99/p95 (ETA +2h).
- Maria: collect 10 sample traces of affected requests and attach KV cache metrics (hits/misses, rehydrate time).

Kevin L: Question — should the adaptive tuner avoid long-prompt sessions? Maybe add a heuristic: if prompt_len_tokens > 1024 or contains tool_call, cap microbatch to 8.
Oliver S: Agreed. Also consider marking requests that trigger KV rehydrate as "latency-sensitive" and route them to low-latency kernel path. We can add a cheap prefilter (inference header) to classify.
Priya N: I'll file an ops change to surface rehydrate counts per pool in the console. Helps product teams see impacted customers.
Maria G: Thanks all — summary: mitigated by rollback of microbatch cap, root cause likely interaction of throughput kernel + KV rehydrate on long prompts + tool-call reentrancy. We'll validate with microbench + pinned kernel experiment.
Kevin L: Nice triage. Add the experiment results to the perf board when done. :thumbsup:
Oliver S: One more note — if we need instant short-term relief we can also tweak KV cache policy to favor prefix retention for tool-call labeled sessions. Longer-term we'll tighten tuner heuristics.
Maria G: I'll update the incident channel with RCA once we have bench numbers.
Maria G: closing temporary thread — followups in perf-epic.
